europe_now.title: Criticism of European Commission Space Support
europe_now.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen faces accusations of an abuse of power following her backing of a major space agreement. Critics have raised concerns over the decision-making process surrounding the high-profile project.

sources.headline: ‘Abuse of power’: Von der Leyen rapped after backing space mega deal

europe_now.title: Central European Energy Policy Stance
europe_now.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has warned that Poland and other Visegrád Group nations will block any European Union measures that lead to increased energy costs. The regional leaders are pushing back against upcoming environmental and market policy proposals.

sources.headline: Poland and other V4 countries will block EU measures that raise energy costs, warns Tusk

top_stories.title: European Union Sanctions Policy Debates
top_stories.summary: EU foreign policy discussions have highlighted divisions over regional sanctions strategy. Officials have debated drawing parallels between measures applied to Russian-occupied territories and other contested areas.
